options.whyZh: 共用紀錄應記下實際在哪一箱發現資料夾；指示沒有要求放回原處。

explanationZh: 共用紀錄用來保留登記箱號和實際發現箱號之間的差異。
evidence: Intake will log each temporary tag under the box number, not the year. If a tagged folder turns up in a different box, leave it unopened and record the change in the shared log. The tag can be thrown away only after the scans have been checked against the folder contents.
